stages.name: Reading for gist

stages.name: Reading for detail
stages.todo: The rest of Exercise 2b. Pairs compare, then take it to the class and ask what Magda actually said about each.

stages.name: Focus on the question words
stages.todo: Exercise 3a, the matching. Then the book’s point: what when the possible answers are many, which when they are few; what kind of before a singular noun, what kinds of before a plural. Drill the question words.

stages.name: Post-reading
stages.todo: Exercise 3b — Diego’s answers matched to the same questions — then 3c, six questions of their choice asked to a partner. Magda’s post is also the exposure for the questions lesson after you.
